thread:
maria: dropping two quick sketches for creds UI — grid vs list. main goals: scannability, density, keyboard nav. screenshots: https://figma.com/file/xyz (comments open)
jamal: nice — immediate thought: grid surfaces status badges well, list feels denser and better for per-key actions.
tom: from infra side list is simpler for checkboxes+bulk operations. grid adds complexity for row selection semantics.
priya: product constraint: show last-rotated prominently. list has a column for it; how do we show in grid without crowding?
maria: idea: compact badge "rotated 3d" in grid with hover for full timestamp. concern: hover-only is inaccessible.
aria-bot: a11y note — hover-only info fails keyboard/screenreader. make the detail reachable by keyboard (focusable element) and use aria-describedby. toasts should use aria-live polite for success messages.
jamal: copy nit — current modal title "Rotate key" feels technical. suggest: "Create replacement token" or "Issue a replacement key". less scary.
tom: undo window question — backend can soft-reinstate within 60s. UX suggests showing a countdown + Undo in toast. is 60s OK?
priya: leaning toward longer undo (5m) to reduce accidental disruption for integrators. but ops warns longer means more security risk.
maria: proposal: default 60s undo visible in toast, org-level setting for up to 5m for enterprise customers. display countdown textually and in activity feed.
tom: implementation detail: make countdown text-based for accessibility: "Undo — 0:54" vs purely animated progress bar.
jamal: layout nit: CTA placement. current mock has "Create credential" in hero left. recommend top-right primary CTA so list/grid header stays consistent when searching.
maria: suggested copy (compact):
```
Primary CTA: "Create credential"
Primary description: "Create an API key for this project — store it securely; you’ll only see it once."
Rotate modal title: "Create replacement token"
Rotate modal body: "Generating a replacement will immediately invalidate the old token after the undo window. Ensure your services are ready."
Rotate toast: "Credential rotated. Old token revoked in 01:00 — Undo"
```
priya: analytics proposal: use these event names: `credential.create.started`, `credential.create.completed`, `credential.rotate.initiated`, `credential.rotate.reverted`. include props: `method: [ui, api]`, `undo_used: [true,false]`.
tom: dev note: current prototype DOM order yields wrong screenreader order — actions are being announced before the key name. we need checkbox -> name -> metadata -> actions in DOM, visually can be rearranged with flex but DOM order must follow reading order.
maria: can we A/B test default view? list as default + toggle to grid vs grid default? i prefer list default for discoverability but open to data.
jamal: :thumbsup: A/B test sounds good. also run a quick contrast check on focus rings — current outline at 3:1 for non-text clickable tokens is borderline.
aria-bot: reminder: focus indicators for interactive controls should meet 3:1 for non-text UI and 4.5:1 when text contrast applies. include visible focus on keyboard nav for all actionable elements.
maria: thanks — i'll update the figma + prototype with: (1) list-first A/B, (2) focusable timestamp detail, (3) updated copy, (4) 60s toast + org setting for 5m. will file small followups for copy, analytics, and dev accessibility tasks. planning a 5-person hallway test early next week.
priya: sounds great. please tag me when you push the prototype.
maria: will do — thanks everyone! :sparkles:
